claims.claim: Second quarter 2026 revenue was $60.80 billion.
Revenue increased 28% from the prior year period.
On a constant currency basis, revenue would have increased by 27%.
Total costs and expenses were $42.03 billion.
Costs and expenses increased 55% year-over-year.
Costs and expenses include $2.40 billion in charges related to legal proceedings.
Costs and expenses include $1.18 billion in severance expenses connected to the May 2026 headcount reduction.
Income from operations was $18.775 billion.
Operating margin was 31%.
Operating margin was 43% in the prior year period.
Net income decreased 14% to $15.848 billion.
Diluted earnings per share fell 13% to $6.18.
Family daily active people averaged 3.60 billion for June 2026.
Family daily active people increased 3% year-over-year.
Ad impressions delivered across the Family of Apps increased by 14%.
Average price per ad rose by 12%.
The Family of Apps segment generated $60.37 billion in revenue.
Family of Apps income from operations was $23.394 billion.
Advertising revenue within the Family of Apps segment was $59.363 billion.
Reality Labs revenue was $431 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
Reality Labs had an operating loss of $4.619 billion for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
The $2.40 billion of legal proceeding charges and $1.18 billion of severance expenses are significant one-time items.
claims.note: The release discloses both amounts but never characterizes them as one-time, non-recurring or otherwise unusual; the 'one-time' label is the analyst's interpretation.

claims.claim: The $2.40 billion of legal proceeding charges was recognized in the second quarter.
Third quarter 2026 total revenue is expected to be in the range of $61-64 billion.
The revenue guidance assumes foreign currency will be an approximately 1% headwind to year-over-year growth based on current exchange rates.
Full year 2026 total expenses are now expected to be in the range of $165-169 billion.
The lower end of the expense outlook was raised to incorporate the legal charges recognized in the second quarter.
The tax rate for the remaining quarters of 2026 is expected to be between 15-17%, absent changes to the tax landscape.
The prior tax rate outlook was 13-16%.
Capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, were $31.08 billion for the quarter.
Full year 2026 capital expenditures are anticipated to be in the range of $130-145 billion.
Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities were $90.26 billion as of June 30, 2026.
Long-term debt was $83.66 billion as of June 30, 2026.
Dividend and dividend equivalent payments were $1.35 billion during the quarter.
A number of youth-related trials are scheduled for this year in the U.S. and may ultimately result in a material loss, amid continued scrutiny on youth-related issues in several markets.
